jordan_cs: FYI — AcmeCorp procurement reached out. They will not accept an invoice unless it includes an official PO number and their VAT ID. Email excerpt below.

jordan_cs: ```From: procurement@acme.com
Subject: PO required to process invoices
Hi Redwood team, please include our official PO number and VAT ID on any invoice before sending to accounts payable. We can issue PO once the invoice draft shows the PO reference. Thanks.
-- Acme Procurement```

maya_finance: Can we issue a proforma invoice while we wait for the signed PO? They often accept a proforma for internal approvals. Do we need SOW attached or any legal copy?

eli_support: Customer also mentioned their card was declined on file earlier this month but they've moved to a PO procurement flow now. Not sure if that affects immediate billing.

billing-bot: ```ERROR 400: invoice_create_failed - missing_required_field: customer_po_number```

acme_procurement: Confirming — we require PO# and VAT id on the invoice header. We'll provide the PO once a draft shows the PO reference. Proposed PO: PO-ACME-2026-009 (we can confirm formally).

jordan_cs: They gave a provisional PO ID (PO-ACME-2026-009). Maya, can finance create a draft/proforma that includes that PO and the VAT ID so procurement can sign off?

maya_finance: I will generate a proforma with PO-ACME-2026-009 and include the VAT ID field. I'll loop in legal for any wording around VAT. ETA ~2 hours.

eli_support: I'll pause automatic invoice runs for acme_corp to avoid accidental invoices before the PO is finalized. Setting internal flag: `suppress_invoices: true`

billing-bot: Invoice suppression toggled for account `acme_corp` by eli_support.

maya_finance: Proforma sent to procurement@acme.com and billing@acme.com. They acknowledged :thumbsup:. They also requested Net45 instead of Net30 — updating terms on the draft.

acme_procurement: Net45 OK. Please include billing contact billing@acme.com and reference PO-ACME-2026-009 on the invoice. We'll sign once the draft matches.

jordan_cs: Great — thanks everyone. Leaving suppressed invoices on until we get confirmation of the signed PO. Reopen thread when final invoice goes out or if PO changes.
